description: AEB1 test vector (ADR 0010). Encrypting plaintext with key, key_id and salt must produce exactly object_base64; decrypting it must produce the plaintext. Regenerated and compared by the Go test TestVectorFile.
plaintext: byte i = i mod 251, for i in 0..plaintext_length-1
nonces: 12 bytes per chunk: 11-byte big-endian chunk counter (starting at 0) followed by 0x00, or 0x01 on the last chunk
chunk_layout: header | chunk 0 | chunk 1 | ...; every chunk is AES-256-GCM(derived key, nonce, plaintext chunk, aad = header) = ciphertext | 16-byte tag; plaintext chunks are 65536 bytes except the last, which holds the remaining 1..65536 bytes (0 only for an empty plaintext). A reader treats a chunk as the last one when nothing follows it and must accept an additional empty last chunk after a full one.
